rule: One-shot, action-matched teaching in a separate opt-in training room. The tutorial keeps a per-lesson seen map; each step asks whether the lesson matches what just happened (per turn for state such as stairs, dark, pain; after each action for open, close, pick up, wear, act); if unseen, it is marked seen and the popup opens (src/gamemode_tutorial.cpp 375-383). The first hostile contact is a training dummy that is immobile, deals zero melee damage and leaves no corpse, so the first hit is safe and visible. Tutorial skills start at level 5 in gun, melee and throwing (init, line 180).
keep: once-per-lesson seen flag, set before the popup opens
zero-risk training dummy for the first hit
one popup per pickup type (armour, weapon, food, tool, gun, ammo) on first pickup
opt-in training room kept separate from the main game
shelter survivor first-meeting flag that changes a cold greeting to a calm one
jobs option hidden while a job is already assigned
change: about 25 words per popup for 375-wide phone (donor snippets run about 35-150 words)
every lesson must have a trigger (LESSON_HIT_MONSTER has a snippet but no add_message call in src)
no forced save warning popup in the training room
all lesson text, names, numbers and dialogue are ours
look_test: On the existing Pit, add a training dummy record (50 hit points, zero damage, immobile, no corpse) and a 25-word popup on the first hit only. Dom taps it five times: does one tip appear once and never repeat? Second beat: pick up three items of three types (armour, weapon, food); each type gets one line, once. Compare with the same Pit fight with no dummy. Pass if Dom says the first hit was safe and clear within 10 seconds and no popup repeats.
